title: Quenched Earthy Slovakian Potato Casserole
description: A hearty, earthy Slovakian dish featuring a rich mixture of potatoes, mushrooms, and spices. Perfect for a sick day, this casserole is diabetic-friendly and comforting.

ingredients.name: Mixture powder
ingredients.notes: available at most European import stores

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sliced potatoes, mushrooms, mixture powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well to combine.
In a separate saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the butter to the potato mixture and toss to coat.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix together breadcrumbs and chopped parsley. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over the top of the potato mixture.
Dot the top of the casserole with the remaining 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
